owner's rule.place in line: the first team on the waitlist is number 1

release package.test results: shown on the run's Summary page

team.how a release happens today: Every change goes through a pull request, and the tests run on it automatically. Every two weeks the lead developer builds a release by hand (about 10 minutes) and copies it to a test server. The volunteer tester tries it over two evenings and writes up any problems. When the tester says yes, the lead developer copies the files to the live server (about 30 minutes) and checks the pages by hand. Undoing a release means rebuilding the old one, about 4 hours.
team.tests today: run automatically on every pull request
team.who checks a release: a volunteer tester tries each release
